objective: Verify finite formal-series programs independently of model predictions.
context: Two demonstration pairs through degree 12; topology and three symbols I,N,S,R; future coefficients withheld. The exact bounded search covers 64 syntax programs, not all analytic functions.

steps.name: Define algebra
steps.description: Write formal-series operations and truncation semantics.

steps.name: Enumerate syntax
steps.description: Identify graph topologies and all bounded candidates.

steps.name: Check demonstrations
steps.description: Use exact integer arithmetic and record first mismatch.

steps.name: Select or abstain
steps.description: Account for candidate-query budget and observational equivalence.

steps.name: Grade continuation
steps.description: Keep future coefficients with the independent oracle.

specific_questions.prompt: Derive the coefficient recurrence for a formal reciprocal with constant term one.
Construct two different formal series that agree through degree 12 and disagree at degree 15.
Explain why a complete bounded syntax search does not prove unique infinite continuation.

native_verifier: EvalMath spiral_ln.algebraic_reasoning_oracle exact finite interpreter and grade.
